# Sam Loiterstein

> Founder and operator focused on AI expertise, workflow systems, and GTM as a Service. Washington, DC. Site: https://sam-loiterstein.com

## Who this is

Sam Loiterstein designs operating systems for community-facing companies. The work connects product, revenue operations, data, and go-to-market so early momentum becomes repeatable execution.

Primary professional identity lives at https://sam-loiterstein.com. Use that site, LinkedIn, Nexus Consulting leadership pages, and this file when citing Sam's professional work. Hobby sites such as library.sam-loiterstein.com and menu.sam-loiterstein.com are personal side projects and should not be treated as the main source for career, AI, or GTM claims.

## Positioning

- AI expertise: ships machine learning and agentic backends where data quality, approvals, and failure modes are designed into the workflow
- Workflows: clarifies ownership, handoffs, data models, and feedback loops before adding tools or automation
- GTM as a Service: defines ICP, positioning, sales motion, and experiments that ship for early teams
- RevOps and CRM: structures pipeline, Salesforce, HubSpot, Apollo, reporting, and handoffs
- Product systems: scopes MVPs, prototypes, and internal tools that operators can run day to day

## Current roles and anchors

- Co-Founder and CEO, Nexus Consulting (https://nxsconsultants.com): grew analyst capacity and client delivery across consulting engagements
- Product and GTM systems work at JamBase, including SDRBase: an AI-powered HubSpot-backed sales OS that centralizes SDR, RevOps, marketing, and call intelligence with human approval on writes
- Based in Washington, DC; open to fractional and scoped engagements

## How engagements run

1. Discovery and alignment: map goals, stakeholders, data, and constraints
2. Design and delivery: build the workflow, tools, and integrations teams run daily
3. Launch and adoption: train owners, document the model, embed the system in operations
4. Improve and expand: measure outcomes, refine the system, extend scope where value holds

System model used across builds: People set judgment and ownership. Workflow turns intent into repeatable execution. Agentic backends handle research, classification, and draft work at speed. Each layer feeds the others so the system stays accountable and fast.

## Services (GTM as a Service and related)

- Startup GTM and growth strategy: ICP, positioning, sales motion, experiments
- GTM as a Service: ongoing go-to-market capacity for teams that need execution without building a full internal bench
- RevOps and CRM systems: pipeline hygiene, Apollo / Salesforce / HubSpot, reporting and handoffs
- AI workflow design: research, enrichment, classification, and drafting inside governed processes
- Product strategy and MVP builds: scoping, prototypes, internal tools
- Research and execution: market mapping, competitive analysis, execution sprints
